reason: The Investor type field carries autocomplete="garbage", an autofill-suppression value, on both sampled states. The field picks Individual or Entity for a third-party investor, so it collects nothing about the user and matches none of the WCAG input purposes.
criterionAnalysis: 1.3.5 applies to input fields that collect information about the user and serve one of the listed input purposes. Investor type picks Individual or Entity for a third-party investor, collects nothing about the user and matches no listed purpose, so 1.3.5 does not apply even though the autocomplete value is the autofill-suppression token garbage. 4.1.2 is not affected: the combobox exposes the name Investor type, its role and its expanded state. No other A or AA criterion covers an autocomplete token.
